environments.detail: A continuous matte microcement floor and backdrop, nearly invisible corner line, organic granular mineral surface. No marble.
Two flat fiber-cement panels forming one crisp architectural seam, low contrast fibers, pale half-gray. No freestanding blocks.
Matte gray diatomaceous-earth plaster wall with delicate trowel texture and mineral floor, two intersecting planes only.
Dark gray cast-in-place board-formed concrete wall, subtle straight formwork seams, matte gray floor.
Charcoal slate with restrained linear layered grain, one simple plane meeting a pale gray floor.
Quiet brushed stainless steel wall, subtle horizontal grain, neutral matte gray floor, no decorative hardware.
Smoked gray glass partition integrated into the background, subtle translucent reflection, gray seamless floor, no extra props.
Pale gray polished plaster corner with a sharp right-angle intersection and non-reflective warm-neutral gray floor.
Near-seamless graphite cyclorama with extremely subtle tonal falloff and matte gray floor, no additional geometry.
Finely sandblasted light concrete wall with discreet porosity and faint horizontal joint, matte gray floor.
Off-white mineral rendered wall and fog-gray floor with minute imperfections, two planes only.
Half-gray and charcoal fiber cement planar intersection, fibrous texture visible only in light, no freestanding solids.

Floorless gray architectural airspace. Two simple integrated VERTICAL matte microcement or fiber-cement planes with gentle tonal separation and discreet joints; no floor, no horizontal horizon or ground-shadow. Soft architectural depth with no supports or props.

compositions.detail: Camera square-on at the screen, symmetric centered hero, eye level. Leave generous horizontal negative space.
Three-quarter view from viewer's left, device gently rotated 12 to 18 degrees around the vertical axis; all screen corners visible.
Three-quarter view from viewer's right, gentle 12 to 18 degree yaw; entire white screen clearly visible.
Lower camera height with modest upward perspective, device remains undistorted and screen readable, centered in canvas.
Device floating in mid-air with a restrained 10 degree counter-clockwise roll, front display facing viewer.
Device floating in mid-air with a restrained 10 degree clockwise roll, front display facing viewer.
Device slightly left of visual center (within central 40%), generous intentional negative space on right, front display completely visible.
Device hovers subtly above the floor without stands, camera near floor height, a single soft contact shadow below.
Camera frames one strong orthogonal architectural seam behind device, device centered and in clear front focus, no additional props.

Near eye-level product photography with a single rectilinear mineral display block or integrated platform as the intentional support. Screen and correct device geometry fully visible; do not aim the camera downward or create a top-down view.

Single standard iPhone 17 lying flat, face-up on mineral floor. Elevated OBLIQUE camera 40–50 degrees above supporting plane, offset from device lower edge; entire white screen visible. The face must NOT become an invisible sliver. This is an intentional screen-visibility exception to the retired general high-view composition, never a 90-degree bird's-eye view.

Single standard iPhone 17 lying flat, face-up on a table-sized (large planar top) monolithic mineral plinth. Camera deliberately elevated to 40–55 degrees above the block top and aimed across the front display; retain screen visibility, realistic device thickness and support top/side. No vertical 90-degree overhead.

Single standard iPhone 17 leaning back ~20 degrees from vertical on a wide single mineral block, supported by a subtle integrated raised facet of that SAME block. Camera adjusts to a modestly elevated oblique front-three-quarter viewpoint matched to the screen, all corners visible.

Single standard iPhone 17 unsupported in floorless gray architectural airspace, ~15-degree three-quarter yaw and ~10-degree roll while keeping all white-screen corners visible; coherent one-camera photograph, no ground shadow.

Exactly one standard iPhone rests leaning with its bottom long edge touching the mineral floor and its upper rear edge leaning against an integrated architectural wall; camera shifts to a modestly raised front-three-quarter view facing white screen. Real contact at two points, no extra prop, no unsupported floating.

lighting.detail: Large frontal diffused studio softbox creates gradual metallic edge highlights and delicate soft shadows.
Low-angle soft grazing light from frame-left reveals mineral surface texture, controlled gentle shadow.
Soft raking light from frame-right illuminates textured architecture and produces faint cast shadow.
Large diffused overhead source, restrained tonal gradients, no harsh or theatrical light beams.
Soft top-left daylight through invisible high window, mild diagonal light transition rather than repeated hard beams.
Soft top-right daylight with broad gentle penumbra and diffused highlights on device glass.
Soft low-key studio lighting on charcoal background, sufficient light to keep product contours readable.
Airy high-key studio lighting with off-white wall and pale gray tones, preserve contrast around white screen.

device_layouts.detail: Exactly one device, the chosen model only; one camera view and one photograph. Never invent a second phone or laptop.
Exactly one 14-inch MacBook Pro on frame-left and one standard iPhone 17 on frame-right. Screens completely visible; Mac keyboard and trackpad visible. No overlap or product duplication.
Exactly one open MacBook Pro slightly behind and one standard iPhone 17 in the foreground, with measurable depth offset, intact silhouettes and neither white screen nor keyboard obscured.

spatial_modes.detail: Devices plausibly rest on a continuous matte mineral floor; delicate contact shadows; no desks, supports, furniture, plinths or props.
Devices hover just above a visible mineral floor. A faint, localized separated shadow indicates small elevation. Floor remains visible; never use this mode for suspended or floorless requests.

Devices float weightlessly in mid-air within the crop. NO visible floor, floor-wall junction, horizon, ground contact, ground reflection or cast shadow on the floor. Background depth comes from quiet vertical architectural planes, graded half-gray tones and controlled reflections on the products; no props or supporting structures.

Device rests on one or two intentional solid monolithic matte gray mineral display plinths, never decorative blocks. For iPhone `flat-face-up`, plinth top is TABLE-SIZED: broad continuous horizontal surface extending generously around the entire phone (~80–140 cm across), visually a simple large concrete slab/volume, but NOT a legged table or wooden desk. For `tilted-supported`, allow a subtle integrated backrest facet as part of same block; require physically credible support and contact shadows. No furniture, decor, props or unrelated blocks.

retired_compositions.reason: Discontinued by art direction, never select or generate.

iphone17.detail: Upright vertical body; if grounded or on-block, credible base-edge contact. Camera near frontal eye level or modest three-quarter. Screen always fully visible.

Body lies flat with back on horizontal surface, white screen facing upward. Camera MUST move to an oblique elevated 40–55-degree viewpoint relative to surface to show all four screen corners. No direct overhead 90-degree flat lay and no eye-level side view.

Phone leans back ~15–30 degrees from upright, visibly stabilized by a coherent built-in mineral backrest or support plane; screen fully visible with camera adapted to tilt. Do NOT depict unsupported impossible balance.
Phone is truly unsupported with restrained yaw/roll in a floorless scene, camera aims at white front display; no floor, horizon, wire or ground shadow.

macbookpro14.detail: Laptop always OPEN with rigid screen raised to show entirely pure-white active display, keyboard and trackpad. Base may rest horizontally on floor/plinth while the screen is raised. Never lay the whole MacBook flat, close the lid, or show screen face-up on a surface.
Entire OPEN laptop floats, display raised at realistic hinge angle, keyboard and trackpad visible, both parts a single rigid articulated device; never closed or laid flat.
